description_full: GigaCloud Technology Inc. provides end-to-end B2B ecommerce solutions for large parcel merchandise in the United States and internationally. The company offers GigaCloud Marketplace that integrates product discovery to payments and logistics tools into one easy-to-use platform. It's marketplace connects manufacturers primarily in Asia with resellers in the United States, Asia, and Europe to execute cross-border transactions across furniture, home appliance, fitness equipment, and other large parcel categories. The company was formerly known as Oriental Standard Human Resources Holdings Limited and changed its name to GigaCloud Technology Inc. in February 2021. GigaCloud Technology Inc. was incorporated in 2006 and is headquartered in El Monte, California.

financial_summary: GigaCloud Technology Inc is a mid-cap technology business with a $2.4B market cap on $1.3B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +38% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.

Returns on capital run at 112% against a 10% cost of capital — a 102-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat, and 24% gross margins are typical of commodity economics where competitors can replicate the product cheaply.

The business throws off $183M in free cash flow — roughly 14 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 1.39× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.
Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 5.8% of the shares, and profit capture is only 0.5× the fair share, suggesting no structural edge inside its industry.
